name: Battery Life
author: Nova
description: What this battery actually gives you: measured runtime per discharge run, average draw, and a full-charge projection built from your own history rather than the instantaneous rate.

barWidget.description: Battery glyph with measured time left, and a click for the history

schema.label: Next to the glyph
schema.description: Time left is measured from your own recent draw, not from the instantaneous reading, so it does not jump around. Right-click the widget to cycle without coming here.
